title: The Broken Prom
author: Ada Yarrow
blurb: Tamsin Thornbury, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before the final audition.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
